rationale: No existing spec treats lazy panel mounting as its own subject. dashboard-variables-panel-level.spec.js (updated in this diff) exercises a variant of scroll-mounting only incidentally, and only to prove a panel-scoped variable stays hidden until its panel mounts — it never asserts the headline placeholder selector [data-test="dashboard-panel-placeholder-<id>"], the placeholder→container transition, or one-way mounting. Lazy mounting is a distinct feature area (own slug, own source files, own spec_path in run-context), so it gets its own spec in Dashboards/ with @dashboards + @dashboard-lazy-panel-mounting tags, registered under Dashboards-Core in ci_matrix.json. The variables spec's scroll-mount coverage is noted for de-duplication: the new spec must NOT re-assert panel-scoped variable laziness, only the component-mount behaviours.
